tolerance.rationale: Pre-registered 2026-09-27 for the whole campaign, before any campaign run. The same bar at every level, so the nine reports say at which (dx, dt) openCARP and cardiacFOAM agree to it; a coarse level outside it is a finding, not a reason to loosen it. 5 ms is about half the 10.9 ms spread of P8 across the paper's codes at its finest level (37.8-48.7 ms, section 6), so passing means agreeing more closely than two of the paper's codes may. Two discretisations are compared: openCARP P1 finite elements with a full mass matrix, read at the nearest node; cardiacFOAM finite volumes, read at the containing cell's centre. Topic B Task 8 (cardiacfoam.md section X) saw dx 0.5 mm, dt 0.01 ms with openCARP's lumped mass; this bar is the 5 ms Task 8 fixed before its own runs, not chosen from its numbers
